rule.name: CachedFutureKeepsFailure
rule.message: This field caches a CompletableFuture and later calls return it, but nothing ever resets it after a failure, so a first attempt that fails is replayed to every later caller instead of being retried. Reset the field when the attempt fails, and only if it still holds this attempt: future.whenComplete((value, error) -> reset(future, error)), or keep the future in an AtomicReference and call compareAndSet(future, null). An exception fits only when keeping the first failure is intended.
